name: Qwen-Image-Edit-2511 serve.py (FastAPI multipart /infer) on EC2
description: samples/models/qwen-image-edit/start.sh + serve.py を systemd で常駐起動する。事前に qwen-image-edit-prepare.json で /mnt/local/compiled_models_tp16/ に V3 TP16 artifacts が揃っている必要がある。 NeuronCore 32-63 (TP=16 DP=2 world_size=32) を専有し、 port {{PORT}} で FastAPI (POST /infer multipart, GET /health, POST /vton/infer alias) を提供。 source は presigned URL 経由で配布。

tasks.name: Verify venv + compiled artifacts
tasks.description: venv と compile artifact (transformer_v3_cfg/ 等) が compiled_models_tp16/ 下にあること。
commands: for d in transformer_v3_cfg vae_encoder vae_decoder language_model_v3 vision_encoder_v3; do
test -d {{COMPILED_MODELS_DIR}}/$d || { echo "[NG] {{COMPILED_MODELS_DIR}}/$d missing — run qwen-image-edit-prepare.json first"; exit 1; }

tasks.name: Stop existing qwen-image-edit.service (if any)
tasks.description: systemd unit があれば一旦止める。

tasks.name: Download + extract source tarball (start.sh + serve.py + run_qwen_image_edit.py + neuron_qwen_image_edit/)
tasks.description: presigned URL から tarball を SERVE_DIR に展開。
commands: test -n '{{SOURCE_TARBALL_URL}}' || { echo '[NG] SOURCE_TARBALL_URL is empty'; exit 1; }

tasks.name: Install runtime Python deps (diffusers, transformers, fastapi, uvicorn)
tasks.description: venv に diffusers/transformers/fastapi/uvicorn が無ければ入れる。compile タスク後なので大半は既存。
commands: {{VENV}}/bin/python -c 'import fastapi, uvicorn, diffusers, transformers; print("fastapi", fastapi.__version__)'

tasks.name: Install qwen-image-edit.service systemd unit
tasks.description: Restart=always で常駐。 NEURON_RT_VISIBLE_CORES={{NEURON_CORES}} で 32 cores 専有 (TP=16 DP=2 world_size=32)。 port {{PORT}} で listen。 PATH_PREFIX={{PATH_PREFIX}} (FastAPI に /qwen-image-edit/health 等の prefix endpoint も載る、 / 直下も生かす)。

tasks.name: daemon-reload + enable + start qwen-image-edit
tasks.description: systemd を再読込してサービスを有効化・起動する。

tasks.name: Local HTTP health check on 127.0.0.1:{{PORT}}/health
tasks.description: compile cache 適用後でも model load + Neuron load で 5-10 min。 最大 1500s 待つ。
commands: if [ "$code" = "200" ]; then echo "[OK] http=$code (attempt=$i)"; curl -s http://127.0.0.1:{{PORT}}/health; echo; exit 0; fi
echo '[NG] qwen-image-edit did not become healthy in 1500s' >&2
